warnings.headline: Yellow Near gale 14-17 m/s Southern Sea of Bothnia
warnings.description:
Late Saturday evening south-southwest 14-17 m/s.; What should I think about?: Pay close attention to the marine forecast and prepare crew and vessel for high winds and seas.
Keep in mind that the wind gusts are often significantly higher than the average wind.; Where?: Southern Sea of Bothnia
warnings.sender: SMHI, Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute
